scripts.dev: npx wrangler@4 dev --local --port 8787 --local-upstream 127.0.0.1:8787 --var DEV_MODE:1 --var AI_PROVIDER:mock --var EXTRA_ORIGINS:http://127.0.0.1:8813
scripts.db:migrate:local: npx wrangler@4 d1 migrations apply teaphuket-chat --local
scripts.db:migrate: npx wrangler@4 d1 migrations apply teaphuket-chat --remote
